title: Diagnosis
description: Result of analysing one leaf photo. Produced by the on-device model (app) or the cloud service (backend) and rendered by the app. Every field is always present; use null when it does not apply. Unknown extra fields must be ignored by readers, so adding optional fields is non-breaking.

status.description: Overall outcome. 'uncertain' means confidence was too low to commit to an answer.

crop.description: Identified plant, e.g. 'Tomato'. Null when unknown or not a leaf.

disease.description: Common disease name, e.g. 'Late blight'. Required for 'diseased'; a best guess or null for 'uncertain'; null otherwise.

pathogen.description: Scientific name of the causal organism, e.g. 'Phytophthora infestans'.

confidence.description: Model confidence in the status/disease, from 0 to 1.

severity.description: How advanced the disease is. Null unless status is 'diseased' or 'uncertain'.

symptoms.description: Visible signs that support the diagnosis. May be empty.

treatment.description: Guidance grouped by approach. Null when not a leaf.

disclaimer.description: Safety note shown with every result.

chemical.description: Chemical controls. Always phrased as 'follow label directions'.

prevention.description: How to avoid it next time.
